programs.title: The Stanford Prison Experiment: Unlocking the Truth
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of a controversial project from 1971, which was intended to show the impact of social situations on behavior.Years later, the participants of the experiment, who as volunteers took on the roles of prisoners and guards in a staged prison, will tell about previously unknown facts.Viewers will learn the key moments of the research that have shaped the perception of human nature for decades.Witness accounts shed new light on the motivations of Philip Zimbardo, who, together with his colleagues, locked 24 students in the university basement.

programs.title: Trafficked with Mariana Van Zeller
programs.desc: Correspondent Mariana van Zeller has been following the trail of smugglers for over fifteen years.During his dangerous work, he meets not only criminals, but also representatives of the justice system, former prisoners and members of local communities.The journalist paints a shocking picture of the gray zone where billions of dollars are traded.The reporter will learn about the activities of counterfeiters, drug dealers, and the illegal sale of weapons, fentanyl and animals.Among her interlocutors was Joe Exotic, the former owner of the controversial zoo.In 2019, he was sentenced to 22 years in prison.
